company.en: Beijing-Dublin International College, Beijing University of Technology
company.zh: 北京工业大学北京都柏林国际学院

en: Led tutorials and supported course delivery through interactive discussions and clear explanations.
Produced course resources including labs, assignments, solution guides, and weekly schedules.
Evaluated coursework and exams using consistent rubrics to ensure fair grading.
Supported student progress through office hours and targeted feedback.
zh: 组织习题课并支持课程教学，通过互动讨论和清晰讲解帮助学生理解重点内容。
编制课程资源，包括实验、作业、解答与周计划安排。
按照统一评分标准评阅作业与考试，确保公平一致。
通过答疑与反馈支持学生学习进展。

en: Shipped and maintained internal business systems in ASP.NET (C#) with SQL backends for retail and enterprise operations.
Built modules for sales, inventory, billing, and reporting with validation logic and schema updates.
Troubleshot production defects, delivered patches, and supported releases and data migrations.
Developed an Android client in Java with SQLite for local persistence and core features.
Provided IT support including remote desktop assistance and basic Cisco/network configuration.
zh: 使用 ASP.NET（C#）与 SQL 后端交付并维护零售与企业内部业务系统。
开发销售、库存、计费与报表模块，完善校验逻辑并优化数据库结构。
定位并修复生产问题，发布补丁，支持版本发布与数据迁移。
使用 Java 与 SQLite 开发 Android 客户端，实现本地数据存储与核心功能。
提供IT支持，包括远程桌面协助与基础 Cisco/网络配置。
